newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SUPREMA MULLS GDR ISSUE FOR VILNIAUS VINGIS.
newsitem.headline: SUPREMA MULLS GDR ISSUE FOR VILNIAUS VINGIS.

text.p: Lithuania's Suprema said on Thursday that it was considering issuing GDRs in Vilniaus Vingis shares it expects to buy after the 30-day period of preemptive rights for current shareholders ends on July 11.
"We are thinking very seriously about issuing GDRs," Suprema head Aidas Galubickas told Reuters.
"If we do it we will do it this year," Galubickas said.
"It will take a month for this decision," he added.
Galubickas said that Suprema had been in talks with banks about acting as partner in the distribution and acting as depository bank but declined to mention any names.
Suprema said earlier this month that it had an agreement with electronic components producer Vilniaus Vingis to take what was left of the company's issue of 2.764 million new ordinary shares.
Vilniaus Vingis General Director Vaclovas Shleinota confirmed the deal with Suprema and said that it was up to the brokerage to decide what to do with the remaining shares.
"Most likely the shares will be distributed outside Lithuania," Shleinota said.
The shares have a face value of five litas and an issue price of 5.8 litas.

Vilniaus Vingis, an A-group company on the Vilnius bourse, said earlier that it was planning to use 75 percent of the funds raised by the new issue to upgrade its production lines and about 25 percent to boost its working capital.
